第486章 前去沿江城大结局（第1页）
蓝若晴看着手中的金锁，心中一动，这么漂亮的东西，真是少见！
“蓝色的双星，蓝星双！长命百岁！云鹤，这个金锁十分有创意，你从哪里弄来的？”
“这是一个叫做沿江城的小镇，镇子上有个‘天佑珠宝行’。据说他们可以根据客人的要求，为客人设计出想要的珠宝，更是有一个懂得创意的老板娘，经营着一家彩帛铺。总之就是传闻的很厉害。云鹤好奇，就派人去试探了一下。没想到，真的有这么好的东西可以拿回来。”
“是离京城近二百里地的地方，靠江而建的一个小镇。”
“云鹤，谢谢你！谢谢你带来的金锁，也谢谢你带来的消息。看来接下来要去的第一站，我已经知道是哪了。”
“小姑奶奶是准备出门吗？要不要云鹤为你安排些什么？”
秦云鹤从怀中拿出一块金牌，交到蓝若晴的手中，说道：“云鹤在江湖中还有些朋友，大多数还是认得云鹤这只牌子的。云鹤知道依小姑奶奶现在的身手，摆平十几个壮汉还是没有问题的。可是人在外面行走，能不招惹事端的情况下，尽量低调些的好。所以如果真的遇到麻烦，小姑奶奶不妨拿出牌子试试看。”
“好！云鹤，你的心意我收下了，你的话我也记住了。我代表我娘和星双谢谢你的礼物，真的是太漂亮了！”
“小姑奶奶能够喜欢，就是云鹤的荣幸，又何来的谢字？”
蓝若晴不再多说话，她知道，她与秦云鹤之间，不需要更多的语言。
当天晚上，蓝若晴与皇甫皓轩一起来到了听雨阁的楼上。
“我知道你原来担心蓝汐冷的事情，现在她的事情提前了，其他的就没有什么困扰你的了。既然如此，我们明日就出发，可好？”
“好！只是这一次，我有个固定的目的地要去。”
“这个金锁中，暗扣了星双的名字。”
“是的！就是这个原因，所以我想会会那个店里的老板娘，我想要一只玉蝶，属于我们两个的玉蝶。”
“我明白了，我们明日就去找那只展翅欲飞的玉蝶！”
第二日，秦云鹤一早就守在将军府的门前。

当蓝若晴出门的时候，她看到了准备齐全的秦云鹤。
“小姑奶奶，这是些干粮，水壶，还有些必备的物品。我知道你与公子这次是第一次出远门，所以给你备了马车。马车虽然走的慢些，可是小姑奶奶的容貌还是不宜外露的。而且此去沿江城并不是很远，马车的速度，三日也可到达。”
“云鹤，还是你想的周到。真是要谢谢你！”
“走！我已经准备很久了！”马车的车夫位置上，一个英俊的少年笑着说话：“再不走，天就大亮了！”
蓝若晴笑着，将自己的手放在皇甫皓轩的手中，坐在马车上。
未来还有多远，会发生什么，她不知道。
她只知道，与皇甫皓轩在一起，就是一种幸福……

Chapter 486 Going to Yanjiang City Finale (Page 1)
Lan Ruoqing looked at the golden lock in her hand, and her heart moved. Such a beautiful thing is really rare!
"Double blue stars, double blue stars! Long life! Yunhe, this golden lock is very creative. Where did you get it?"
"This is a small town called Yanjiang City. There is a 'Tianyou Jewelry Shop' in the town. It is said that they can design the jewelry they want according to the customer's requirements. There is also a proprietress who knows how to be creative and runs a colorful silk shop. In short, the rumors are very powerful. Yunhe was curious, so he sent someone to test it out. I didn't expect that such a good thing could be brought back."
"It is a small town built near the river, nearly two hundred miles away from the capital."
"Yunhe, thank you! Thank you for the golden lock you brought, and thank you for the news you brought. It seems that I already know where the first stop is."
"Are you ready to go out, my aunt? Do you want Yunhe to arrange something for you?"
Qin Yunhe took out a gold medal from his arms, handed it to Lan Ruoqing's hand, and said: "Yunhe still has some friends in the world, and most of them recognize the Yunhe brand. Yunhe knows that with my aunt's current skills, it is no problem to deal with a dozen strong men. But when people are walking outside, it is better to keep a low profile as much as possible without causing trouble. So if you really encounter trouble, my aunt may as well take out the brand and give it a try."
"Okay! Yunhe, I accept your wishes and I will remember your words. On behalf of my mother and Xingshuang, I would like to thank you for your gift. It is really beautiful!"
"It's Yunhe's honor to be liked by my aunt, so where does the word "thank you" come from?"
Lan Ruoqing stopped talking. She knew that there was no need for more words between her and Qin Yunhe.
That night, Lan Ruoqing and Huangfu Haoxuan came to the upstairs of Tingyu Pavilion together.
"I know you were originally worried about Lan Xileng, but now that her matters have been brought forward, nothing else will bother you. In that case, let's set off tomorrow, okay?"
"Okay! Only this time, I have a fixed destination to go to."
"Xingshuang's name is hidden in this golden lock."
"Yes! That's why I want to meet the proprietress of that store. I want a jade butterfly, a jade butterfly that belongs to both of us."
"I understand, let's go find that jade butterfly spreading its wings tomorrow!"
The next day, Qin Yunhe stood guard in front of the general's mansion early in the morning.
When Lan Ruoqing went out, she saw Qin Yunhe who was fully prepared.
"Sister-in-law, here are some dry food, a kettle, and some necessary items. I know that this is your first trip with the young master, so I have prepared a carriage for you. Although the carriage moves slower, it is still not suitable for my sister-in-law to show her face. Moreover, it is not very far to Yanjiang City. At the speed of the carriage, it can be reached in three days."
"Yunhe, you are so considerate. Thank you so much!"
"Let's go! I have been preparing for a long time!" In the driver's seat of the carriage, a handsome young man said with a smile: "If you don't go, it will be dawn!"
Lan Ruoqing smiled, put her hand in Huangfu Haoxuan's, and sat on the carriage.
How far into the future and what will happen, she doesn't know.
She only knew that being with Huangfu Haoxuan was a kind of happiness...
